name: Terra Sool
description: Terra Sool was a planet located within the Terra Sool system of the Expansion Region. It was liberated from the Confederacy of Independent Systems by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi in 22 BBY, during the Clone Wars.
